evidence.note: FreqExit enables dynamic early-exit inference for Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) image generation models by exploiting that high-frequency image details emerge only in later decoding stages, using curriculum-based layer-dropout supervision and a wavelet-domain frequency-consistency loss, achieving up to 2x speedup with minor quality loss.
evidence.title: FreqExit: Enabling Early-Exit Inference for Visual Autoregressive Models via Frequency-Aware Guidance
